items.q: He walked up to me, he says 'hey, Jeff,' just like, saying hey man or hey baby or brother.

ctx.x: Oh well, anyway, if I didn't I'll repeat myself. Carmyte? [Mike] Thompson was playing the dance in the Elks Hall, so I run into a violin player named T. Moore. He walked up to me, he says 'hey, Jeff,' just like, saying hey man or hey baby or brother. At that time he says 'hey Jeff. Are you hip?' He says all right, come go with me.
